label: ② UI/UX Pro Max：清晰的精品选礼入口
direction: Use the verified Minimalism & Swiss Style guidance: a precise twelve-column logic, generous white space, monochrome white/black, geometric sans typography at regular-to-medium weights, strong legibility and an obvious next action, essentially no shadows, no gradients and no decorative textures. Reject Liquid Glass, feature-card grids, gold luxury shorthand and social-proof sections. Turn the product task into an exceptionally clear boutique opening: restrained brand/navigation, a single selected artwork emphasized through scale, the contrasting artwork introduced quietly, and an understated service-oriented invitation into choosing a gift. Group information by proximity; only one dominant action. Design should feel easy and intentional at realistic UI sizes, not an oversized arts poster. Clear user journey and progressively revealed information are this direction's main quality, but the image remains a calm premium homepage, not an application dashboard.
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE design comp for "proof of cake", a niche onchain birthday art gifting platform for crypto-native people, 1536x1024 edge-to-edge. The client wants the feeling of a curated luxury boutique: restrained, personal, selective, not a marketplace. Platform visual identity stays independent of artwork aesthetics. The attached tall sheep ink painting is ARTWORK CONTENT ONLY, not the site's style. Include it intact, and one contrasting colorful pixel birthday artwork; a third small colorful abstract work is optional. Native colors and proportions stay intact. Show a real navigable screen and the start of the following section, no device frame, poster, mockup of a physical book, framed wall, room, vase, plinth or showroom render. No catalogue grid, fake prices/editions/artists/reviews, giant checkout form or crypto telemetry. Real UI content: brand "proof of cake", navigation "作品", "关于", "连接钱包", brief "为一个人，珍藏一份心意。", a clear understated "挑选生日礼物", and small "设计预览". No excessive tags or filter pills. Evaluate this design as a complete calm website opening. Follow ONLY the particular design direction below; do not copy a prior website layout.
